A '''''Lucrehulk''-class battleship''' was part of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] led by the ''[[Nihilist]]'' over [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. During the [[Rebellion on Felucia|rebellion]] there around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led task force intervened. Master [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] ordered them to concentrate all fire on the Droid Control ship. A pair of [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] trained by [[Mavra Zane]] destroyed the Receiver Stations. The vessel was then destroyed.

==Behind the scenes==
The Droid Control Ship appears in the Jedi Destiny portion of ''[[Kinect Star Wars]]''.
